name: dlthub-setup
description: Start here. Sets up uv, dlt[hub] and the dlthub workspace, then installs the dltHub toolkit for your task with the dlthub CLI.

interface.longDescription:
dltHub Setup is the entry point to the dltHub AI harness. It prepares your project to build data pipelines with dlt and dltHub.

What it does:
- Checks if uv, dlt[hub] and the dltHub workspace are installed.
- Shows you a plan and asks you to approve it before it runs a command.
- Installs uv, dlt[hub] and the dltHub workspace (dlthub-init from PyPI).
- Installs the dltHub toolkit for your task with the dlthub CLI: load data from a REST API, a SQL database or files, explore and transform the data, or deploy the pipeline to the dltHub platform.

Who it is for: data engineers and developers who build dlt pipelines with a coding agent.

Limits:
- It needs network access to PyPI and GitHub.
- The plugin has no MCP server of its own. The dlthub CLI adds the dltHub MCP server and the toolkits to your project.
- dlthub-init sends usage telemetry. Ask the skill to add --no-telemetry to turn it off.
- Use it once per project. When the workspace is set up, use the installed toolkits.
